status: protocol recorded before new witness executions
purpose: Distinguish a useful conditional construction from generic test adequacy and from a novel research contribution.

hard_gates.P2-C: Admit only a semantic law supplied by the API contract or language semantics. State assumptions and a counterexample outside them.
hard_gates.P2-D: Name an executable input/sequence/oracle construction and the inference it eliminates. Reject constructions requiring a complete requirement graph or a full correctness oracle first.

candidates.law: Alias-preserving isolated transport of mutable state
candidates.construction: Generate shared and disjoint two-accessor cell motifs, transfer/clone the aggregate, write through one accessor, read through the other, check source isolation.
candidates.independent_reuse: T25 superjson-error-stack-serializat__GFuzuNB: repeated Error references through serialize/deserialize; distinguish applicability evidence from finding another bug.
candidates.admission: T13 same capture behavior plus isolated transfer; T25 repository object-identity contract and supported Error roundtrip. This admission and the API adapters are manual.
non_claims: A two-node motif is complete for arbitrary programs
Issue interpretation or API adaptation is automated

candidates.law: A deterministic current-state query is independent of retained query-cache history
candidates.construction: Warm a stable predicate instance, mutate data, compare its membership with a new instance of the same pure predicate on the same world.
candidates.admission: Only pure predicates over declared dependency traits, after synchronous updates complete. Exclude Added/Removed/Changed and snapshot/subscription semantics.
non_claims: A mismatch by itself identifies which execution is correct

candidates.law: Present-with-undefined and absent are distinct when defaulting is explicitly restricted to absence
candidates.decision_before_execution: Useful contract-specific discriminator, not a general constructive abstraction. It requires the exact defaulting contract; do not infer that contract from the implementation or generalize to all sentinel values.

evaluation_rules: Read original instructions, patches and trajectory steps; existing reports only locate evidence.
Separate implementation, validation and agent-process explanations.
Run against copies of original candidate repositories; do not change frozen artifacts.
Record generated cases and complete execution output, including passes and failed construction attempts.
Use passing controls and an explicitly labelled local repair or mutant only for causal triangulation; never count them as independent real bugs.
Report prior-art overlap even if it removes a novelty claim.
